subject: general
question: Which one of the following is NOT associated with the Indian Freedom Struggle?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Ne**w deal__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **New Deal** was a series of programs, public work projects, financial reforms, and regulations enacted by President Franklin D. Roosevelt in the United States between **1933 **and **1939**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **The Wavell Plan** is a plan proposed by the British government to end the impasse in India.
 
• Lord Wavell, who succeeded Lord Linlithgow as Viceroy of India in 1943, drafted this plan.
 
• **The Cripps Mission** was an unsuccessful attempt by the British government in late March 1942 to win complete Indian collaboration and support for their World War II activities. Sir Stafford Cripps, a senior politician, led the mission.
 
• **The Indian Statutory Commission, **commonly known as the **Simon Commission,** was a panel of seven Members of Parliament led by Sir John Simon. The commission arrived in British India in 1928 to study constitutional reform in Britain's largest and most important possession.
